hypotheses: F/K is the finite twist extension of degree dividing ell-1

citation.locator: Section 1, pp. 595-596, uniqueness and case (ii); case (iii) excluded for odd ell

decisive_checks: Nonzero inertia evaluation survives on a pro-ell Sylow
Prime-to-ell inertia index handles ramified F/K
Local target prime cannot be the missed prime
Unramified target cocycle is identically zero on target inertia
mechanical_scope: A Bezout identity and boundary fixtures only; no formal local-correspondence verification.
excluded_conclusions: Use of Uchida Proposition 1 to obtain the uniform bound
novelty: Not claimed; application of the cited local theorem.
review_authority: Engineer assessment; native independent Reviewer acceptance remains required.
